# crosswork_srte_odn_templates (Resource)

This resource can manage an SR-TE on-demand next-hop (ODN) template. Create and update wait until the devices named in `head_end.name` are ready in Crosswork, as set by the `device_ready_mode` and `device_ready_timeout` arguments of the provider configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "crosswork_srte_odn_templates" "example" {
  name  = "cwtest-odn"
  color = 4242
  head_end = [
    {
      name = "build-router-1"
    }
  ]
  maximum_sid_depth              = 8
  pce_group                      = "cwtest-pce-group"
  bandwidth                      = 1000
  source_address                 = "192.0.2.1"
  dynamic_pce                    = true
  dynamic_flex_alg               = 129
  dynamic_metric_type            = "igp"
  dynamic_metric_margin_absolute = 5
  dynamic_affinity_rules = [
    {
      action = "include-any"
      color  = ["red"]
    }
  ]
  dynamic_disjoint_path_type                 = "node"
  dynamic_disjoint_path_group_id             = 5
  dynamic_disjoint_path_sub_id               = 1
  delay_measurement_profile                  = "delay-profile-1"
  delay_measurement_logging_delay_exceeded   = true
  performance_measurement_reverse_path_label = 2000
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `color` (Number) SR policy color. Traffic whose route carries this color is steered into the policy that the template creates.
  - Range: `1`-`4294967295`
- `name` (String) Template name

### Optional

- `bandwidth` (Number) Requested bandwidth in kbps. Not supported together with SRv6.
  - Range: `1`-`4294967295`
- `delay_measurement_logging_delay_exceeded` (Boolean) Log when the delay is exceeded. Set to `true` or leave unset.
- `delay_measurement_profile` (String) Delay measurement profile of the head end. Not `default`; leave it unset for the default profile.
- `dynamic_affinity_rules` (Attributes Set) Affinity rules of the path computation (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dynamic_affinity_rules))
- `dynamic_disjoint_path_group_id` (Number) Disjoint group id. Required with the type.
  - Range: `1`-`65535`
- `dynamic_disjoint_path_sub_id` (Number) Disjoint sub group id
  - Range: `1`-`65535`
- `dynamic_disjoint_path_type` (String) Disjointness type. With `dynamic_disjoint_path_group_id` it makes the paths of the group disjoint.
  - Choices: `link`, `node`, `srlg`, `srlg-node`
- `dynamic_flex_alg` (Number) Flexible algorithm (prefix-SID algorithm)
  - Range: `128`-`255`
- `dynamic_metric_margin_absolute` (Number) Absolute metric margin. Use this or the relative margin.
  - Range: `0`-`2147483647`
- `dynamic_metric_margin_relative` (Number) Relative metric margin in percent. Use this or the absolute margin.
  - Range: `0`-`2147483647`
- `dynamic_metric_type` (String) Metric type of the path computation
  - Choices: `hopcount`, `igp`, `latency`, `te`
- `dynamic_pce` (Boolean) Delegate the path computation to the PCE. Set to `true` or leave unset.
- `dynamic_segments_sid_algorithm` (Number) SID algorithm constraint
  - Range: `128`-`255`
- `head_end` (Attributes Set) Head ends of the template. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--head_end))
- `instance` (String) Select an instance of the provider configuration by its name. Leave it unset to use the default instance.
- `liveness_detection_backup` (String) Backup liveness detection profile. Needs a profile.
- `liveness_detection_invalidation_action` (String) Action when the liveness session invalidates the path
  - Choices: `down`, `none`
- `liveness_detection_logging_session_state_change` (Boolean) Log a change of the liveness session state. Set to `true` or leave unset.
- `liveness_detection_profile` (String) Liveness detection profile. Not `default`. Use this or delay measurement.
- `maximum_sid_depth` (Number) Maximum SID depth.
  - Range: `1`-`255`
- `pce_group` (String) PCE group
- `performance_measurement_reverse_path_label` (Number) Reverse path label of the performance measurement
  - Range: `16`-`1048575`
- `source_address` (String) Source address of the policies. An IPv6 address needs SRv6.
- `srv6_locator_behavior` (String) SRv6 behavior of the locator
  - Choices: `ub6-insert-reduced`
- `srv6_locator_binding_sid_type` (String) SRv6 binding SID type
  - Choices: `srv6-dynamic`
- `srv6_locator_name` (String) SRv6 locator name. Setting any SRv6 attribute turns on SRv6 for the template.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The id of the object

<a id="nestedatt--dynamic_affinity_rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `dynamic_affinity_rules`

Required:

- `action` (String) Rule action
  - Choices: `exclude-any`, `include-all`, `include-any`

Optional:

- `color` (Set of String) Names of the affinity colors of the rule. NSO returns them sorted.


<a id="nestedatt--head_end"></a>
### Nested Schema for `head_end`

Required:

- `name` (String) Name of a device in the Crosswork inventory that is onboarded to NSO

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import crosswork_srte_odn_templates.example "<name>"
```
